author: kalepail
body:
PR #182 merged as `1e94ccdde8098d0317ab63cf0d9fe174f7f7dfce` and reached production on 2026-09-29.

Worker Version ID: `5774bb56-d1f9-4725-ae65-bfd35e3c0bce`.
Cloudflare reports 100% traffic on that version. The MCP initialize response reports the exact merged source revision.

The live catalog has 60 operations, 20 whole skills, and 202 sections. All 282 IDs match the committed manifest. All 80 operation and whole-skill exact-ID searches pass. RWA remains excluded under #167.

Live reads verified the new Stellar standards and Trustless Work Core API files. Their URLs carry the reviewed pinned commits. The updated content markers are present.

The canonical route, playground, terms, skill health, and both alias routes return HTTP 200. Unauthenticated MCP returns HTTP 401. The usage tail consumer and daily retention schedule checks pass with the active `sdf` profile.

All 544 offline routing rows keep their IDs, ranks, and scores. Complete operation objects and shared schemas remain unchanged. Independent GPT-6 Astra high and GPT-6 Sol high reviews passed. GitHub CI, build, mirror, golden, finding, and secret checks passed.

The local and HTTP tool definitions match after sorting JSON object keys. Their raw hashes differ because their JSON key order differs. The instructions hash matches exactly.

Release evidence: `.agents/rounds/2026-09-29-truth-maintenance.md` and its `production-verification.json` receipt.
